recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future edits should be made only under a later applied bodyStructure decision, such as a successor to FHIR-54843, or if the work group explicitly restores ServiceRequest.bodySite.
issue_request: FHIR-50355 asked to clarify when ServiceRequest.bodySite versus ServiceRequest.bodyStructure should be used. Its Applied/Persuasive-with-Modification resolution was to update the ServiceRequest.bodySite comment to prefer bodyStructure, direct coded use to bodyStructure.includedStructure.structure, and keep laterality in bodyStructure.includedStructure.laterality rather than precoordination.
initial_application: Commit 5fa034fbd0046c5854b323dc6d7ff37c5d6f7239 directly applied the approved text to the ServiceRequest.bodySite comment. OO WGM minutes for 2025-05-12 record the same motion and vote, explaining that because ServiceRequest was already FMM 4, the comment was the narrow place to highlight the distinction.
additional_context: Later Applied issue FHIR-53203 changed the model: ServiceRequest.bodyStructure is now CodeableReference(BodyStructure) with the body-site example binding, and ServiceRequest.bodySite was deprecated and then removed from the active StructureDefinition. FHIR-53203 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 4a40e560695e898d7bca24950f8edd0044c29f74. Later FHIR-54843 and FHIR-53826 show broader bodyStructure harmonization/guidance is still a separate later path, not a reason to restore the removed bodySite comment.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active ServiceRequest StructureDefinition has no ServiceRequest.bodySite element to carry the old comment, and the notes already point body-site/body-system representation to bodyStructure.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 issue introduced ServiceRequest.bodyStructure alongside bodySite, creating the distinction FHIR-50355 clarified.
Applied R6 harmonization changed ServiceRequest.bodyStructure to CodeableReference(BodyStructure) and removed ServiceRequest.bodySite; an existing combined-branch audit commit already represents it.
Resolved-change-required issue owns broader bodyStructure BnR/cardinality/harmonization work but is not Applied/Published in this run scope.
Triaged comment asks why ServiceRequest and Procedure now differ after ServiceRequest.bodySite deletion; it is not a final source-edit decision.
